window.basis_short: Cited: the Lancet Commission on Global Surgery's 2-hour access indicator (share of people within 2 hours of a facility that can do caesarean section, laparotomy and treatment of open fracture)

travel.text: Estimated drive time = state terrain factor x 2.30 x km^0.842 minutes, from the straight-line km. Fitted to 934 free-flow car trips (OSRM) from 30 post offices. Error: leave-one-anchor-out log SD 0.26; the shown range (x e^-0.52 to x e^+0.52) held 94.6% of held-out trips. The factor is the origin state's (reference/terrain_multiplier.csv). Free-flow means no traffic and no waiting: real trips take longer. Islands: sea travel is not modelled, so no minutes are shown there.
